Neither recommends the side; both lean Under on the total (Dimers Under 156.5, SportsGambler Under 155.5), and Dimers puts Seton Hall's chance of covering -17.5 at 50.5%. The one availability item: Seton Hall's Devin Williams (quadriceps) was listed day-to-day and questionable for this game in a Nov 24 report.
